id.instruksi: Baca tiap pesan di HP-mu: seret ke 'aman' atau 'mencurigakan'. Pesan mencurigakan jangan dibalas, jangan diklik, dan tunjukkan ke orang dewasa.
id.i1: Kamu terpilih jadi bintang iklan! Kirim fotomu dan nomor HP sekarang.
id.i2: Ini admin game. Akunmu diblokir 10 menit lagi kecuali kamu kirim kata sandi.
id.i3: Pulsa gratis 100 ribu! Klik tautan ini dalam 5 menit.
id.i4: Aku kasih koin game gratis, asal kamu rahasiakan dari orang tuamu.
id.i5: Ketik PIN kartu ATM ayahmu untuk mengambil hadiah.
id.i6: Kirim alamat sekolahmu, nanti aku kirimi hadiah.
id.i7: Transfer Rp10.000 dulu supaya hadiahmu bisa dikirim.
id.i8: Nenek: Besok Nenek datang membawa pisang goreng.
id.i9: Wali kelas: Jangan lupa bawa baju olahraga hari Kamis.
id.i10: Teman kelompok: Tugas poster kita kerjakan di perpustakaan, ya.
id.i11: Paman: Selamat ulang tahun! Semoga sehat selalu.
id.i12: Ibu: Makan siang sudah ada di meja.
id.i13: Pelatih pramuka: Kumpul jam 2 di lapangan sekolah.

en.instruksi: Read each message on your phone: drag it to 'safe' or 'suspicious'. Don't reply to or tap suspicious messages, and show them to an adult.
en.i1: You've been chosen for an advert! Send your photo and phone number now.
en.i2: This is the game admin. Your account is blocked in 10 minutes unless you send your password.
en.i3: Free 100k phone credit! Tap this link within 5 minutes.
en.i4: I'll give you free game coins, as long as you keep it secret from your parents.
en.i5: Type your dad's bank card PIN to collect a prize.
en.i6: Send me your school's address and I'll mail you a gift.
en.i7: Transfer Rp10,000 first so your prize can be sent.
en.i8: Grandma: I'm coming tomorrow with fried bananas.
en.i9: Class teacher: Don't forget your sports kit on Thursday.
en.i10: Group mate: Let's do our poster project in the library.
en.i12: Mum: Lunch is on the table.
en.i13: Scout leader: Meet at 2 o'clock on the school field.
